top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic RBC GranFondo Whistler's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
7,500ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
99ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Road-specific control matters at RBC GranFondo Whistler. Practice on coastal highway with sustained gradual climbing: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 76 miles.
76 miles on coastal highway with sustained gradual climbing burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At RBC GranFondo Whistler, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of RBC GranFondo Whistler. Train it until it feels boring.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on coastal highway with sustained gradual climbing can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at RBC GranFondo Whistler. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
7,500ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 7,500ft of climbing on coastal highway with sustained gradual climbing does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for RBC GranFondo Whistler's 76 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at RBC GranFondo Whistler. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at RBC GranFondo Whistler rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on coastal highway with sustained gradual climbing to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, VO2max, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 76 miles of coastal highway with sustained gradual climbing in Vancouver to Whistler, BC.
